description: Clustering accuracy across GNN feature spaces for Flyvis cell-type recovery, using GMM, ARI, and NMI scores, visualized via UMAP.
facts:
CAPTION: Cell-type clusterability across feature spaces of the general-form GNN (group lasso 25, σ = 0.05, fold cv00 of experiment 2). Each panel scatters the 13,741 neurons of the central 217-column Flyvis model coloured by ground-truth cell type (65 classes). Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM, 100 components) accuracy, Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), quoted top-left of each panel, are the analysis pipeline’s own scores of each feature stack (the stack standardised per feature); UMAP is shown for visualisation only when the feature space is > 2D. (a) Ground-truth (τ, Vrest) plus 8 connectivity statistics of the true W (mean, SD, minimum and maximum of the incoming and of the outgoing weights; 10D). (b) The same from the learned ˆτ, ˆVrest and ˆ W (10D). (c) Learned 2D node embedding ai shown directly (no projection). (d) ai concatenated with the learned (ˆτ, ˆVrest, 
FACTS:
- experiment: 2: GNN MLP(ai,aj,vi,vj), group lasso, model noise
- arm: cond_l25
- runs: 5 of 5 landed
- cells: noise: noise_005
- dataset: flyvis_noise_005_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_conductance
- embedding dim: 2
- model noise sigma: 0.05
- epochs: 1
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 500
- training: one-step
- MLP precision: fp32
- regularisers: W_L1 7.5e-05, W_L2 7.5e-07, g_phi_input_group_L1 25.0, g_phi_weight_L1 0.14, f_theta_weight_L1 0.025
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
